Name: Truffled
Author: BurninWeeknd
Description:
Collector that collects all of your truffles.
Adds to possible loot pool rewards inside skull cavern.
Defaults to a 5% drop chance. Upon first launch a config.json will be made inside the mod folder and drop chance may be adjusted.
